attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd cluster (v3.4.30) across node1/node2/node3 via apt-installed etcd-server with static bootstrap discovery over their peer URLs. Verified cross-member consistency (write on node1, read confirmed on node2/node3), verified continued availability under a single-member outage (stopped node3, wrote/read successfully via node1+node2 at 2/3 quorum), and verified node3 fully caught up on rejoin. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time node restart protocol on all three nodes: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id + etcd active + data present) on each, issued a background-scheduled reboot on each node individually (quorum preserved throughout, never more than one node down), polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual reboot occurred, and confirmed etcd active, cluster membership at 3/3, endpoint health true for all endpoints, and prior keys readable post-restart.
